    Ektypos 
    
  
    
  
    Print it. No typos.
    
  
    A label designer and Bluetooth printing tool for thermal printers, currently the Fichero D11s label printer and Fichero A4 printers. Everything runs in this single file, offline. Designs are stored only in this browser, and nothing is sent anywhere except to your printer.
    
  
    Copyright © 2026 The Ektypos authors. Ektypos is free software, licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version. It comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.
    
  
    
  
    Ektypos is not affiliated with the maker or sellers of Fichero printers. "Fichero" is used only to describe compatibility. Protocol documentation consulted: 0xMH/fichero-printer, together with Ektypos's own analysis of the Fichero Android app.

    Data, numbering and dates
    
  
    
    
    Put fields like {Name}, {counter} or {date} in text, barcodes and QR codes. Each record prints one label. Add filters after a bar to reshape a value, for example {Name|upper} or {SKU|replace:/-/ /g}.

    Filter and quantity
    
    
    
      
    
      
    
    
    
    
    
    
    Generate a series
    
    
    Make serial numbers without a spreadsheet. Brackets expand: [001-250] numbers with zero padding, [0-100/5] in steps of 5, [A-F] letters, [red|green|blue] a list. Several brackets give every combination, for example Shelf [A-C]-[01-20].

    Dates
    
    
    
    
    {date+30} gives the date 30 days from today, {date-7} a week ago.
    
    
    Template tester
    
    
    
    
    
    
    Field filters reference
      
    Chain filters with |. They work on any field, including {counter}, {n} and {date}. Regular expressions use JavaScript syntax between slashes, with optional flags (g, i, m, s, u).
    
      
    
      
    upper · lower · title · trimChange case or remove spaces at both ends.
    
      
    left:3 · right:4 · mid:2,5Keep the first 3, the last 4, or 5 characters from position 2.
    
      
    pad:6 · pad:6,* · padr:10Pad on the left with zeros (or a chosen character), or on the right with spaces.
    
      
    replace:/\s+/-/gReplace what the expression matches. Use $1, $2 for captured groups.
    
      
    remove:/[^0-9]/Delete every match.
    
      
    match:/(\d{4})$/Keep only the match, or its first group in brackets. Empty if nothing matches.
    
      
    if:/^EU/:Europe:OtherPrint the first text if it matches, the second if not. $1 works here too.
    
      
    part:-,2Split at a separator and keep part 2.
    
      
    add:10Add to the last number in the value, keeping its zero padding (A-009 becomes A-019).
    
      
    number:2Format as a number with 2 decimals.
    
      
    date:DD/MM/YYYYRead the value as a date and write it in another format.
    
      
    default:n/aUse this text when the value is empty.
    
      
    prefix:€ · suffix: kgAdd text only when the value isn’t empty.
